data.name: Explore Cape Cod in a Day
data.headline: For all ages! • 9 Hours
data.description:
# Book your luxury tour with us today!

## Duration 
9 Hours

## About
Available in English, Spanish and Turkish.

Chauffeured driving and walking included.

Cape Cod is one of the best places in the world for outdoor recreation and scenic beauty. Its uniqueness makes sightseeing a year-round adventure. Located off the southeastern tip of Massachusetts, the Cape consists of vibrant towns and villages. During this day tour, you will be greeted by breathtaking views as you explore the charms of the area.

In the town of Chatham, you will enjoy saltwater beaches, the beautiful lighthouse and stunning mansions.  Chatham is a foodies’ destination spot with numerous restaurants to choose from. Orleans is an art lovers’ paradise and has over a dozen art galleries. Provincetown has a bohemian town with art galleries lining Commercial Street. Check out the mansions of long-ago sea captains or take a stroll on the beach. In Truro, learn about and sample wines at Truro Vineyards. Wellfleet is well-known for its shellfish, including the famous "Wellfleet oysters." 

Cape Cod offers so much in a day– quaint streets, whale watching, sandy beaches, picturesque lighthouses, delicious foods, and whimsical small shops. There is something to delight all your senses.
